title: hemerocallis fulva var. disticha
intro: Hemerocallis fulva var. disticha, commonly known as orange daylily, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the lily family (Hemerocallidaceae). The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Hemerocallis fulva var. disticha include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and act as an antimicrobial agent, making it a valuable remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
